method.committee: n = t + 2, generated once per (algorithm, t)
method.sign: t partial signatures, sequential (total); signPerSigner = sign / t

definitions.canonicalBytes: encodeBundle() length (stored bundle; SHA-256 anchored on-chain)
definitions.noPkBytes: canonicalBytes minus t embedded public keys (optional optimisation)
definitions.jsonBytes: UTF-8 length of JSON.stringify(bundle) (value in the original paper)
